changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS unaccent

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION f_unaccent(text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT AS $func$ SELECT public.unaccent('public.unaccent', $1) $func$

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE poems DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS search_vec

ALTER TABLE poems ADD COLUMN search_vec tsvector GENERATED ALWAYS AS ( setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(name, ''))), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', f_unaccent(coalesce(content, ''))), 'C') ) STORED
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_poems_search_vec ON poems USING gin (search_vec)

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_poems_name_unaccent_trgm ON poems USING gin (f_unaccent(lower(name)) gin_trgm_ops)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_authors_name_unaccent_trgm ON authors USING gin (f_unaccent(lower(name)) gin_trgm_ops)
